rows.culsma_evidence: The clarified lysate is applied to the column and sampled for QC.
The retained input aliquot becomes a prepared gel sample.
The same named column carries binding, wash, and elution states.
The collected flowthrough supplies its QC sample.
The pooled washes supply the wash QC sample.
The first eluate is prepared for QC and returned as a purified fraction.
The second eluate is prepared for QC and returned as a purified fraction.
The prepared input is heated and loaded into its lane.
The prepared flowthrough is heated and loaded into its lane.
The prepared wash is heated and loaded into its lane.
The first prepared eluate is heated and loaded into its lane.
The second prepared eluate is heated and loaded into its lane.
The stained/destained gel supplies the structured QC image.
